mapper.select: SELECT j.JNL_DATE AS STAT_DATE, j.TERM_GROUP_ID AS TERM_GROUP_ID, a.BRANCH_CD AS BRANCH_CD, j.TERM_ID AS TERM_ID, SUBSTR(j.JNL_TIME, 1, 2) AS STAT_HOUR, NVL(TRIM(j.TR_TYPE), ' ') AS TR_CD, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN NVL(j.TR_MEDIA_CD, ' ') IN (' ', '2') THEN #{bankCd} ELSE j.BANK_CD END) = #{bankCd} THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS TR_BANK_TYPE, NVL(j.TOTAL_TYPE_CD, ' ') AS CLOSING_TYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{statDate}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') AS DAY_WEEK, COUNT(*) AS TR_CNT, NVL(SUM(j.DISPENSE_AMOUNT), 0) AS TR_AMT, NVL(SUM(j.SURCHARGE), 0) AS SURCHARGE_AMT FROM T_TRANSACTION_JOURNAL j INNER JOIN T_ATM a ON a.TERM_GROUP_ID = j.TERM_GROUP_ID AND a.TERM_ID = j.TERM_ID WHERE j.JNL_DATE = #{statDate} AND TRIM(j.TR_RESULT) = '0000' AND a.PROTOCOL_TYPE = 'T' AND a.ATM_STATUS = '1' GROUP BY j.JNL_DATE, j.TERM_GROUP_ID, a.BRANCH_CD, j.TERM_ID, SUBSTR(j.JNL_TIME, 1, 2), NVL(TRIM(j.TR_TYPE), ' '), CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN NVL(j.TR_MEDIA_CD, ' ') IN (' ', '2') THEN #{bankCd} ELSE j.BANK_CD END) = #{bankCd} THEN '1' ELSE '2' END, NVL(j.TOTAL_TYPE_CD, ' ') ORDER BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, STAT_HOUR, TR_CD, TR_BANK_TYPE, CLOSING_TYPE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRANSACTION_DAILY_TOTAL (STAT_DATE, TERM_GROUP_ID, BRANCH_CD, TERM_ID, STAT_HOUR, TR_CD, TR_BANK_TYPE, CLOSING_TYPE, DAY_WEEK, TR_CNT, TR_AMT, SURCHARGE_AMT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{termGroupId}, #{branchCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{termId}, #{statHour}, #{trCd}, #{trBankType}, #{closingType}, #{dayWeek}, #{trCnt}, #{trAmt}, #{surchargeAmt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_USER u WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_ATM_GROUP g WHERE g.TERM_GROUP_ID = u.DEPT_CD AND NVL(g.TERM_GROUP_NAME, ' ') <> NVL(u.DEPT_NAME, ' ') )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_USER u SET u.DEPT_NAME = (SELECT g.TERM_GROUP_NAME FROM T_ATM_GROUP g WHERE g.TERM_GROUP_ID = u.DEPT_CD) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_ATM_GROUP g WHERE g.TERM_GROUP_ID = u.DEPT_CD AND NVL(g.TERM_GROUP_NAME, ' ') <> NVL(u.DEPT_NAME, ' ') )
